command:
set -eu ip route replace default via 10.77.10.254 || echo "WARN: failed to set default route via 10.77.10.254" >&2 echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" > /etc/resolv.conf echo "nameserver 8.8.4.4" >> /etc/resolv.conf mkdir -p /srv/scl-data /srv/www /srv/files /srv/db /var/log/scl /tmp/agents cat > /etc/scl-host.json <<'JSON' { "topology": "Two Router", "network": "dmz", "host": "dmz-1", "role": "Web server", "ip": "10.77.10.11" } JSON cat > /srv/scl-data/README.txt <<'DATA' Topology: Two Router Network: dmz Host: dmz-1 Role: Web server No AI-generated data was requested for this host. DATA cp /srv/scl-data/README.txt /srv/www/index.txt || true cp /srv/scl-data/README.txt /srv/files/share.txt || true printf '

SCL web server

%s
' "$(cat /srv/scl-data/README.txt)" > /srv/www/index.html python3 -m http.server 80 -d /srv/www & touch /tmp/scl-host-init-ready tail -f /dev/null

set -eu
ip route replace default via 10.77.20.254 || echo "WARN: failed to set default route via 10.77.20.254" >&2

{

JSON
cat > /srv/scl-data/README.txt <<'DATA'

:
